milestones.note: Core AoE skill for early damage output.
Mobility tool to teleport around the battlefield.
AoE powerhouse fueled by Dominance resource.
Unlocks resource generation through Command Fallen.
Allows Lesser Demon skills to generate resources.
Grants additional minions and buffs demon damage.
Summons a demon army for protection.
Applies Eviscerate to all elites on first hit.
Boosts all damage and grants permanent Unstoppable.
Mimics Command Fallen and Bombardment for extra damage.

strategy: Scale Command Fallen and Bombardment through resource generation while summoning demons for protection and additional AoE damage, progressing smoothly to level 70 with a strong early and late-game power curve that needs minimal setup to be effective.

paragon.note: Level glyphs as high as comfortable in speedruns, push further once geared. Maxroll shows this build's Paragon board pathing through an interactive planner (D4Planner) rather than as plain text, so the exact board order can't be faithfully scraped - check source_url for the visual layout.
